en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a dramatic cliffside building perched high above a valley. A cable car (funivia) with a person standing on top hangs over the drop, running between the cliff and the town in the valley below. Mountains rise in the distant background, and an urban settlement with a river and bridges is visible in the lower right. The caption at the bottom reads "Funivia Trento-Sardagna."
